open_points.subject: public_op:delivery_store.project_lock
open_points.text: the folders below the state folder that lead to it
open_points.question: What is the exact lock-file path and therefore which folders must project_lock create for a project id?
options: <state_dir>/<LOCKS_FOLDER>/<project_id><LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX>
A lock file directly below state_dir
A nested or sharded per-project directory layout below state_dir
open_points.default_guess: Use <state_dir>/<LOCKS_FOLDER>/<project_id><LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX> and create LOCKS_FOLDER when absent.

witness.initial: The state folder exists, but no lock-related child folder or lock file exists for the project.
events: module:photo_delivery calls delivery_store.project_lock for the project.
module:delivery_store derives the lock address and creates the folders leading to it.
outcomes: The service creates a different directory layout or a lock directly under state_dir.
witness.observer: The installer or operator inspecting and granting access to the state directory sees different paths and folders.

open_points.subject: public_op:delivery_store.project_lock
open_points.text: `state_unavailable` when the lock cannot be taken (A6 rule 5).
open_points.question: Does failure to create a required parent folder or the lock file count as a lock that cannot be taken and therefore produce state_unavailable, and which newly created folders may remain after such a failure?
options: Map every parent-folder or lock-file creation failure to state_unavailable and retain any folders already created because A6 removes none.
Propagate the operating-system error for folder creation, reserving state_unavailable for lock acquisition.
Map creation failure to state_unavailable but require creation to leave no new folder behind.
open_points.default_guess: Return state_unavailable for any failure preparing or taking the lock, and retain any folders already created.

witness.initial: The state folder exists and is writable enough to create the lock folder, but creation of the lock file then fails.
events: module:delivery_store creates the missing lock folder.
module:delivery_store fails to create or open the lock file.
outcomes: The caller receives M08 state_unavailable and the new folder remains.
The caller receives a raw operating-system error, or the implementation attempts to remove the new folder.
witness.observer: module:photo_delivery and an operator inspecting the state folder see the different error and residual state.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 4
open_points.text: that first creation is the only write of an operation that writes nothing else
open_points.question: Must this say that creation of the lock file and all missing parent folders is the complete set of writes, rather than calling a multi-object creation the only write while saying the operation writes nothing else?
options: Treat creation of the lock file and every missing parent folder collectively as the permitted lock-initialization writes.
Treat only creation of the lock file as a write and do not count directory creation.
Require the folders to pre-exist so that lock-file creation really is the only write.
open_points.default_guess: Treat all lock-initialization filesystem changes collectively as the permitted writes.

witness.initial: Neither the lock folder nor the project lock file exists.
events: module:delivery_store creates a folder and then creates the lock file.
outcomes: The operation conforms because both creations collectively constitute its lock-initialization write.
The operation violates the passage because it performed at least two filesystem writes and wrote something besides the lock file.
witness.observer: A test or filesystem auditor counting state-directory changes sees the difference.

open_points.subject: A3 rule 5
open_points.text: Conditions 1 to 4 write nothing except the project lock (A6 rule 4).
open_points.question: Must this passage also permit creation of the folders leading to the project lock when one of conditions 1 to 4 occurs on first use?
options: Change it to permit the project lock file and its missing parent folders.
Define “the project lock” to include its parent-folder creation.
Require parent folders to exist before these conditions can run.
open_points.default_guess: Permit creation of the project lock file and its missing parent folders.

witness.initial: The project has no lock folder or lock file, and the requested source name fails condition 1.
events: module:delivery_store creates the missing folder and lock file.
module:photo_delivery rejects the source name under A3 rule 5 condition 1.
outcomes: The failed delivery may leave both the folder and lock file, as the changed A6 rule requires.
The failed delivery may write nothing except the lock file, as A3 rule 5 states.
witness.observer: The caller's test or an operator inspecting the state folder sees whether the folder was added.

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_delivery.deliver_project_photo
open_points.text: Creates at most one placement of a project and content, and the project lock file on first use.
open_points.question: Must the state impact also state that the operation can create the folders leading to the project lock on first use?
options: Add the lock file and its missing parent folders to the state impact.
Use “project lock state” as a defined term that includes the file and folders.
Assert that the folders always pre-exist before deliver_project_photo runs.
open_points.default_guess: Add the missing parent folders to the state impact.

witness.initial: The state folder exists, but the lock folder and project lock file do not; the photo cannot be delivered after the lock is taken.
events: module:photo_delivery takes project_lock, which creates the missing folder and lock file.
The delivery returns failed before writing an image or placement record.
outcomes: The operation leaves a folder and a lock file.
Its stated impact is read as allowing only the lock file in addition to a placement.
witness.observer: The caller's state-impact test or an operator inspecting the state folder sees the additional folder.

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_delivery.mark_photo_published
open_points.text: Creates at most one mark of a placement, and the project lock file on first use.
open_points.question: Must the state impact also state that the operation can create the folders leading to the project lock on first use?
options: Add the lock file and its missing parent folders to the state impact.
Use “project lock state” as a defined term that includes the file and folders.
Assert that the folders always pre-exist before mark_photo_published runs.
open_points.default_guess: Add the missing parent folders to the state impact.

witness.initial: A placement exists, but the lock folder and project lock file do not.
events: module:photo_delivery takes project_lock, which creates the missing folder and lock file.
The mark is refused before a mark record is written.
outcomes: The refused operation leaves a folder and a lock file.
Its stated impact is read as allowing only the lock file when no mark is created.
witness.observer: The caller's state-impact test or an operator inspecting the state folder sees the additional folder.

open_points.subject: public_op:delivery_store.project_lock
open_points.text: Creates the project lock file on first use and holds an operating system lock (A6 rule 4).
open_points.question: Must creation of the lock file and its parent folders be made durable before the held lock is returned, or is ordinary filesystem creation without directory synchronisation sufficient?
options: Synchronise the created file and affected directories before returning the held lock.
Rely on ordinary creation; durability is required only for stored images and records.
Require durability for the lock file but not for its parent folders.
open_points.default_guess: Use ordinary creation because A6 explicitly requires durability only for stored images and their records.

witness.initial: The lock folder and file are absent.
events: module:delivery_store creates them and returns the held lock.
The process or host crashes after the caller proceeds but before filesystem metadata is durable.
The service restarts and accesses the same project.
outcomes: The folder and lock file are guaranteed to survive the crash.
Either may be absent and is recreated on the next use.
witness.observer: The restarted service and an operator inspecting the state folder see the difference.
